fields.name: calls
fields.description: `socket.calls`: the calls of the last 4 s, oldest first. The sum of the costs is the call cost now (node/server_functions.js:5354-5361).

fields.name: climit
fields.description: `limits.calls`, 200 (node/server.js:257). Caution: a socket without a character has a limit of 50, not this value (node/server.js:4905-4906).

fields.name: total
fields.description: `socket.total_calls`: the number of events that this socket sent since it connected.
